provider_evidence_records.field_family: Intrinio US fundamentals coverage, history, update latency, business-use licensing, ADR limitation, and status-page incident evidence.

evidence_source_refs.source_title: Intrinio Bronze Fundamentals Data Feed Plan
evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://intrinio.com/guides/fundamentals-bronze. Intrinio documents standardized and as-reported financial statements, raw filings, company metadata, security reference data, REST / Snowflake access, update timing after SEC processing, 5 years of trailing fundamentals history, 10,000+ active and delisted companies, 50,000+ active and delisted securities, two-week trial, and business-use licensing with raw redistribution limits. This is reviewed coverage and license evidence, not provider selection.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://status.intrinio.com/. Intrinio status page exposes current component status, 90-day uptime, past incidents, incident feeds, and support links. Status pages support drift monitoring, but they do not prove field coverage or data correctness.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://help.intrinio.com/how-can-i-see-if-the-api-has-experienced-downtime-or-outages. Intrinio says customers can use the API status tracker for downtime and incident alerts, and should file support tickets when status is clean but user-side issues persist. This supports a future incident workflow, not production readiness.

WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://help.intrinio.com/adrs-non-us-based-companies. Intrinio states ADR fundamentals coverage is under construction and may contain filings or calculation errors. This is an explicit coverage limitation that must become a universe filter or blocker before implementation.

missing_required_evidence: Exact project coverage counts across the intended US investable universe, backtest window, active/delisted tickers, ADRs, ETFs, SPACs, CIK mappings, fiscal years, statement families, and required fields.
Sample-row validation for accepted_date, filing_date, updated_date, is_latest, amendments, restatements, units, and standardized vs as-reported field semantics.
User-approved license path for local storage, retained private artifacts, non-display use, raw redistribution restrictions, and cost ceiling.
Fallback rule when Intrinio ADR, delisted, amended, or missing-field coverage is incomplete.
Incident SLA, retry, cache, and freeze policy tied to the status page and support-ticket workflow.
limitations: Intrinio coverage and status documentation narrows P1 blockers but does not make the provider implementation-ready.
ADR coverage warnings must be reflected in future universe and fallback rules.
No Intrinio API calls, sample rows, trial, subscription, or license approval were performed.
